mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below zero monthly change signals weakening economic output that depresses corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO monthly change is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% monthly growth indicates rising price pressures that trigger monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) levels reflect sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% monthly growth signals robust residential construction activity that drives short-term economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST monthly change exceeds 0.5%.
